name: Shindou Setsuna
source:
As a student, she is studies hard while also working as a Gist apprentice and exorcist.  
She has a bright and friendly personality, is easy to get along with, and can quickly become close with most people.

Currently she travels around various locations, exorcising demons that appear.  

Despite having endured many painful experiences in her battles with demons that she cannot share with others, she continues to fight on.  

Lately, she has been enjoying relatively peaceful days, leading a tranquil school life.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/Nightmare_x_Deathscythe/]official site[/url]]
